responsibility: Defines the rs6000 backend’s machine predicates used by instruction recognition, expansion, constraints, and peepholes. It classifies operands by register file, address form, constant range, vector capability, fusion suitability, and many target-specific properties such as SF subregs, VSX/Altivec legality, TOC/fusion memory forms, and quad-memory requirements, providing the operand-testing vocabulary shared across the PowerPC machine descriptions.
